      "scan": "$(R^{q}j_{\\ast})F=0$ si $q>0$",

      "kind": "misprint_in_print",

      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$(R^{q}j_{\\ast})F=0$ si $q>1$",
      "note": "The vanishing bound should be q>1; R¹j_*F need not vanish. The TeX keeps the printed bound."
    },
    {
      "page": 247,
      "where": "Proof of 5.1, reference after « Ensuite on applique »",
      "scan": "IX 2.15",

      "note": "The printed reference is erroneous. The TeX records IX 2.15 in the first argument of \\sisi and already corrects it to IX 2.14."
    },
    {
      "page": 247,
      "where": "Proof of 5.1, paired references to VIII 5.5 and 5.8",

      "note": "The second external-reference macro repeats « VIII », which is not repeated in the print."
    },
    {
      "page": 249,
      "where": "Bibliography [2], Godement's initial",
      "scan": "Godement, P.",
